name: Sportradar Soccer
description: Sportradar Soccer v4 JSON HTTP API: competitions, seasons, schedules, match summaries, team profiles and standings. Requires an API key entitled to Soccer v4; keys for other Sportradar products are not interchangeable. Default trial: 30 days, 1,000 requests per rolling 30 days and 1 request/second. Production access and coverage depend on contract. Docs: https://developer.sportradar.com/soccer/reference/soccer-api-overview

credential_fields.name: api_key
credential_fields.label: API key
credential_fields.description: Personal API key from the provider account. Endpoint access depends on the subscribed plan.

credential_fields.name: access_level
credential_fields.label: Access level
credential_fields.description: Select the access level assigned to your Soccer API key.

tools.name: list_competitions
tools.description: Provides a list of all available Soccer competitions. Requires Soccer v4 product access.

tools.name: list_competition_seasons
tools.description: Provides historical season information for a given competition. Valid competition IDs can be found in the Competitions feed. Requires Soccer v4 product access.

competition_id.description: Unique Id of a competition, found in the [Competitions](https://developer.sportradar.com/soccer/reference/soccer-competitions) endpoint.**Example:** `sr:competition:17`

tools.name: get_daily_schedule
tools.description: Provides a list of scheduled matches for a given day. Requires Soccer v4 product access.

start.description: The number of items to skip before starting to collect the result set.Default: `0`Example: `start=200` to receive a 2nd page of results (if necessary)Note: You may alternatively use `offset`

limit.description: The number of items to return.Maximum: `200`Default value: `200`Example: `limit=5`**Note**: Pagination may be required to pull all data within this feed. By default, the feed will return 200 sport events.

tools.name: get_event_summary
tools.description: Provides real-time match-level statistics for a given match. Including player and team stats, scoring info, and channel availability. Please note that data returned is determined by coverage level. Requires Soccer v4 product access.

sport_event_id.description: Unique Id of a sport event**Example:** `sr:sport_event:50850733`

tools.name: get_standings
tools.description: Provides detailed standings info for a given season. Requires Soccer v4 product access.

season_id.description: Unique Id of a season, found in the [Seasons](https://developer.sportradar.com/soccer/reference/soccer-seasons) endpoint**Note:** The API provides a maximum of 3 seasons per competition — 2 previous seasons and 1 current season.**Example:** `sr:season:118689`

round.description: Standings for a specified round number. If the round number is not specified, the last round is displayed by default.Example: `round=2`

live.description: Determines whether standings are based on live scores. If not specified, live standings are returned.Visit our [Coverage Matrix](https://coverage-matrix.sportradar.com) for live standings availability by competition.Example: `live=false` (ignore live standings)

tools.name: get_team_profile
tools.description: Provides top-level information for a given team, including the full team roster, manager, home venue, and team colors. Requires Soccer v4 product access.

tools.name: get_season_schedule
tools.description: Provides basic match information for all matches for a given season, including scoring and match coverage. Requires Soccer v4 product access.

season_id.description: Unique Id of a season, found in the [Seasons](https://developer.sportradar.com/soccer/reference/soccer-seasons) endpoint**Note:** The API provides a maximum of 3 seasons per competition — 2 previous seasons and 1 current season.**Example:** `sr:season:118689`

start.description: The number of items to skip before starting to collect the result set.Default: `0`Example: `start=200` to receive a 2nd page of results (if necessary)Note: You may alternatively use `offset`

limit.description: The number of items to return.Maximum: `1000`Default value: `1000`Example: `limit=5`**Note**: Pagination may be required to pull all data within this feed. By default, the feed will return 1,000 sport events.
